purpose: Source-authored contracts for Cove gunpowder, ranged support, Focus, and reload predicates. This is static traceability only and does not authorize gameplay mutation.
validationState: source-prepared-static-only; runtime proof is still required before gameplayAllowed can become true.

futureStaticFacts: exact pirate-family classifier may be added only as authored data, never from SID/name text
forbiddenSubstitutes: unit SID or display name containing pirate counted as pirate classifier
Cove faction membership counted as gunpowder or pirate
shooter role counted as gunpowder or pirate
law name or icon counted as unit classifier
battle payload counted without exact unit SID classifier proof
RequiresGunpowderOrPirate.notes: Gunpowder/Pirate predicates currently have exact authored gunpowder=yes unit facts for the Cove gunpowder shooter line. Pirate-specific classification is not a separate current fact and must not be inferred from names.

requiredRuntimeSemantics: exact reload ability or reload event identity
forbiddenSubstitutes: hero energy pool existence counted as Focus event
ability config existence counted as reload event
ranged attack counted as reload
turn start counted as Focus or reload without exact event proof
gunpowder unit classifier counted as Focus or reload
RequiresFocusOrReload.notes: Focus/reload is an event identity predicate. Static energy/ability surfaces can prepare diagnostics, but gameplay needs committed Focus credit/spend or exact reload event proof.

forbiddenSubstitutes: Space or Arcane school access counted as gunpowder or ranged support
generic support spell counted as ranged support
Cove faction membership counted as gunpowder or ranged support
shooter role counted as gunpowder without gunpowder fact
spell cast event counted without supporting unit or Focus correlation
RequiresGunpowderOrRangedSupport.notes: Storm Charts support requires exact gunpowder or ranged-support semantics. Static unit role facts can prepare the classifier, but runtime still needs supporting unit/side correlation and spell-cast ordering.

requiredRuntimeSemantics: credit recipient side or hero identity
credit ordering after qualifying spell/support event
forbiddenSubstitutes: hero energy pool existence counted as Focus credit
Focus UI value counted without committed credit event
spell cast event counted as Focus credit
gunpowder support classifier counted as Focus credit
side energy payload counted without recipient and ordering proof
RequiresFocusCredit.notes: Focus credit is a committed resource/event predicate. Static energy payload surfaces are preparation only; gameplay requires recipient identity, ordering, and idempotence proof.

requiredRuntimeProof: battle unit SID to authored classifier correlation proof
exact reload ability or event proof
